issues.on_page: p5 prints only Taxes 4,131,556; the parts 3,614,456 / 181,226 / 335,874 are in the p4 General Fund column (Property / Motor Vehicle / Other)
issues.issue: Split lines cite a page that prints only the combined line (split_from names p4). The GF tax pieces detail[0..2] cite p5 and keep the labels 'Taxes (property)' / 'Taxes (motor vehicle)' / 'Taxes (other)' instead of the printed breakdown labels ('Property Tax' under the rename rule, 'Taxes: Motor Vehicle', 'Taxes: Other') that the tax-split standard asks for. Holt and Garfield counties have had this fixed. The Road disbursement splits detail[30..32] (2,327,293 / 150,000 / 9,791) and Inheritance splits detail[35..36] (40,670 / 203,791) cite p6, but those amounts are printed only on p4.

issues.on_page: Taxes: Nameplate Capacity 335,930 (Statement of Activities p2)
issues.issue: This tax split piece keeps a made-up label. The printed breakdown label on p2 is 'Nameplate Capacity' (under Taxes). Its sibling piece receipts[4] was relabelled to the printed 'Other' in this fix pass, but this one was not.

issues.on_page: General Fund Taxes: Other 335,874; Statement of Activities p2: Nameplate Capacity 335,930, Other 32,068
issues.issue: The GF 'Other' tax line is almost certainly nameplate capacity tax (county-wide nameplate 335,930), but the report doesn't print it by fund, so other taxes is defensible (marked review).

issues.on_page: Charges for Services 175,093 (Red Cloud Ambulance 101,345 + Blue Hill Ambulance 69,570, p14)
issues.issue: Nonmajor charges for services are about 98% ambulance fees (Ambulance Fees / ambulance/rescue fees category).
Highway allocation is assumed, not printed. The Road Fund intergovernmental line has no breakdown (marked review).

issues.on_page: Public Works 81,852 (all Noxious Weed Fund, p14)
issues.issue: The extractor rules put noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. It was kept as streets/highways to match the statement's Public Works function.
